registration: Git commit fixes this plan; no external registry submission is claimed
failures: Do not replace seeds or remove failed replicates. Any nonfinite/missing output blocks the cell from a confirmatory summary until a logged code repair and same-seed full-cell rerun.
access_boundary: No SPR, MIRA, clinical, fresh reservation, candidate response or structural score file is an analysis input.
multiplicity: One named primary estimand. All grids and additional methods are labeled sensitivity/descriptive; no search for a positive result.
reporting: Retain all cell/replicate results and failed runs; report mean, MCSE and 95% Monte Carlo intervals. Biological generalization is not inferred.
title: Selection optimism on correlated null candidate scores
generator: For each independent panel draw labels balanced, then permute their order. Scores Z[i,j]=sqrt(rho)*G_common[i]+sqrt(1-rho)*G_candidate[i,j]; all G independent N(0,1), independent of labels. Selection/shadow streams are independent. No model fitting.
nesting: Within each n,rho,replicate generate 50 candidates once; k uses the first k columns. The shared selection panel and shadow panel remain fixed across k.
selection: Choose the largest selection AUROC; exact ties choose the lowest candidate index. Shadow data never select candidates or k.
auc: Mann-Whitney rank AUROC, average ranks for ties; both classes required.
shadow: 200 balanced independently generated observations for all cells; apply the selected candidate column only.
naive_test: scipy.stats.mannwhitneyu(positive_scores,negative_scores,alternative=greater,method=exact) for n=14 without ties; method=asymptotic,use_continuity=True otherwise. All-constant control has p=1. Report naive p<=0.05 after selection as a false-pass event, not a corrected inferential claim.
mc_intervals: Mean optimism: mean +/- 1.96*sample_SD/sqrt(5000). Event rates: Wilson 95% intervals. Also report replicate 2.5/97.5 percentiles separately as spread, not CI for the mean.
controls: rho=1: all candidate columns exactly identical; k cannot improve AUROC or change tie-selected index.
all_constant: every score zero on both panels, AUROC=0.5, p=1, retained rather than filtered.
interpretation: Estimate finite-panel selection optimism under specified dependence; no biological performance threshold, no claim of methodological novelty by itself.
stream_keys: E5 scenario excludes k, so all k share prefixes. E6 scenario excludes effect, so effects share latent draws and resampling indices. Distinct streams for labels, common/candidate scores, shadow and resampling.
